content.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local channels at absolute time 1.0 s; angles are unwrapped and use radians, while angular velocities use rad/s.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame, where x is forward, y is left, and z is up; its unit is metres.","Both joints have a constant applied torque of -0.039323043935170054 N·m, with viscous damping of 0.05 N·m·s/rad; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m over the scheduled interval [0.4359, 0.5359) s.","The joint_limit_by_T boolean means either joint has reached an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by 1.0 s; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
